credibility.line: No promise has come due yet in this window

threads.title: BeYon store count expansion
threads.note: Last mentioned Jun 2026; not repeated on the 2 calls since

history.speaker: Arun Narayan
history.quote: Yes, like we said earlier, we would certainly like to expand to around 10 to 12 stores in two to three cities and then kind of see how that...

history.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
history.quote: In the Investor Day and prior, we have said that more of 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin, we would be around that plus/minus something can happen.

history.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
history.quote: I think we still, Mihir, would like to anchor our margin target at around 11%. Growth remains a priority. As I spoke about in also, that the way gold prices are behaving in Indian market, because of various reasons, they are many times at discount to international prices. There are different kind of pulls and pressure in the market, and which we also need to respond to. We would not, as far as FY27 is concerned, change our stance on margins.

threads.title: Jewellery division revenue growth guidance and targets

history.basis: CAGR over next three to four years
history.speaker: Arun Narayan
history.quote: So, I think in the past, we have said between 15% to 20%. So, in a sense, that holds good and we hope to do that and maybe do a bit better.

history.speaker: Ajoy Chawla
history.quote: If you're looking for what is that we are targeting, we are targeting, as always, a double-digit aggressive growth, and that's something which we shared even in the Investor Day. Those targets and our ambitions don't go away.

history.speaker: Ajoy Chawla
history.quote: So for us to target a healthy double-digit growth in jewellery is inevitable.

threads.title: TEAL normalized margin trajectory
threads.note: No reported number to check this against

history.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
history.quote: Overall, long term, growth is on a very strong wicket, but the normalized margin would be gradually gravitating towards 12% to 15%, 16%.

threads.title: Overall business trajectory for Investor Day goals

history.speaker: Ajoy Chawla
history.quote: We think we are on trajectory for delivering the kind of growths that we had promised in the Investor Day. And we hope that we can, in fact, better it in the current year because we've started very well.

threads.title: CaratLane EBIT margin trajectory
threads.note: No reported number to check this against

history.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
history.quote: But if you look at the entire H1 margin profile of CaratLane, still remains healthy, still remains as per our plan that gradually their EBIT margin should start inching up from 8% to 9%, and then further from there in next couple of years.

synthesis.headline: Management delivers on jewellery margin targets, but drops store expansion goals while revenue targets remain unverifiable.

points.text: The jewellery division margin target of 11.0-11% for FY27 is on track, supported by an actual 12.76% EBIT margin in FY27 so far.
BeYon store count expansion promised 10-12 units for Jun 2026 was dropped after not being repeated on the last two calls.
Growth guidance for jewellery, TEAL margins, CaratLane EBIT, and overall Investor Day goals remain unverifiable due to qualitative metrics.
Annual revenue reached 87584.0 crore by Mar 2026, with annual PAT increasing to 5073.0 crore and operating margins at 9.5%.

bull.text: Annual revenue grew significantly to 87584.0 crore in Mar 2026 alongside a PAT of 5073.0 crore.
Cash from operations rebounded strongly to 5590.0 crore by Mar 2026.

bear.text: Borrowings stand at 27638.0 crore against an equity of 18263.0 crore, resulting in a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.51.
ROCE declined to 21.0 from 25.0, and the cash conversion cycle lengthened to 211.0 days.
